name: Mac
title: ClipDiff for Mac
requirements: macOS 13 Ventura or later · Apple Silicon & Intel
install: Download ClipDiff-macOS.zip from the latest GitHub release. Extract it, move ClipDiff.app to Applications and open it. Quit ClipDiff before updating.
pathCopy: Use Copy as Pathname in Finder or copy full paths from your editor. One or two absolute paths are accepted, one per line, optionally double-quoted.
fileNote: Text files up to 16 MiB are read. Finder aliases use their target’s contents. Binary files contribute a filename and “binary file” reason; other unusable files also give a reason.

integration.setup: Choose Finder Menu Settings… in ClipDiff, then enable ClipDiff Finder Integration in System Settings.
integration.single: Right-click a file. With no capture, ClipDiff asks you to copy first. The command is hidden for the file already captured.
integration.pair: Select exactly two files; no prior capture is needed. Finder can launch ClipDiff even when it is closed.

viewers.discovery: Tools installed in Applications, such as MacDiff, Kaleidoscope and Beyond Compare, should be detected automatically. Select yours under Diff viewer.
viewers.custom: Missing? Use Choose Application… to select its app or executable. Custom tools must accept two file paths as arguments.

privacy.markers: ClipDiff ignores concealed or transient clipboard items and marks copied diffs the same way. These markers ask compatible clipboard managers not to retain them; they cannot guarantee it.
